    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Artist_Sketches" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Create_Project" name="Create the 3D model project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Initial_STL" name="Send STL file"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Initial_STL" name="STL file sent"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Artist_Changes" name="Receive change request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Changes" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Revise_Project" name="Make requested changes"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Revised_STL" name="Send revised STL file"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Revised_STL" name="Revised STL file sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Start_Artist_Sketches" targetRef="Create_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Create_Project" targetRef="Send_Initial_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Send_Initial_STL" targetRef="End_Initial_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Start_Artist_Changes" targetRef="Revise_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Revise_Project" targetRef="Send_Revised_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Send_Revised_STL" targetRef="End_Revised_STL"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" sourceRef="Send_Sketches" targetRef="Start_Artist_Sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL_Initial" sourceRef="Send_Initial_STL" targetRef="Catch_STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" sourceRef="Send_Changes" targetRef="Start_Artist_Changes" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL_Revised" sourceRef="Send_Revised_STL" targetRef="Catch_STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/3d-model-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Change requests"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Confirmation of satisfaction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Sketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_STL" name="Receive STL file">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?" default="Flow_NotSatisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Changes" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Confirmation" name="Confirm satisfaction" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Choose_Color" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Is the color at home?" default="Flow_ColorNotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Check_Amount" name="Check how much color is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Is it under 100 grams?" default="Flow_AtLeast100"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Add_ShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Order_Color" name="Order color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorMerge" name="Continue with plastic" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_PlasticAvailable" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_PlasticAvailable">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[plasticAvailable]]></bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Turn_On_Printer" name="Turn on the printer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Split" name="Heat printer and generate G-code" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Heat_Bed_Extruder" name="Heat the bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_PrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status" attachedToRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Generate_Gcode" name="Generate G-code from the STL file"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Join" name="Heating and G-code ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Print_Model" name="Print the model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printing" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Send_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Send_Sketches" targetRef="Catch_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Catch_STL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Send_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[satisfied]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Send_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Send_Changes" targetRef="Catch_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_07" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Choose_Color"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_08" sourceRef="Choose_Color" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorInStock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Check_Amount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[colorIsAtHome]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotInStock" name="Not at home" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Order_Color"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Check_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Add_ShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[amountInGrams < 100]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Add_ShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Order_Color" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorMerge" targetRef="Catch_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Catch_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Turn_On_Printer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Turn_On_Printer" targetRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Split" targetRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Split" targetRef="Generate_Gcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" sourceRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder" targetRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Generate_Gcode" targetRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatingAndGcode_Join" targetRef="Print_Model"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Print_Model" targetRef="End_Printing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Artist" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Create_Project" name="Create the 3D model project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_STL" name="Send STL file" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Artist_Wait" name="Wait for change requests or confirmation" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Changes" name="Receive change requests" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Revise_Project" name="Make requested changes"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Confirmation" name="Receive confirmation of satisfaction" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Artist" name="Project accepted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Start_Artist" targetRef="Create_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Create_Project" targetRef="Send_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Send_STL" targetRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait" targetRef="Receive_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Receive_Changes" targetRef="Revise_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Revise_Project" targetRef="Send_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_08" sourceRef="Receive_Confirmation" targetRef="End_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" sourceRef="Send_Sketches" targetRef="Start_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" sourceRef="Send_STL" targetRef="Catch_STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" sourceRef="Send_Changes" targetRef="Receive_Changes" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
